title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 21: David's census, the pestilence on Israel and the altar on Ornan's threshing floor.

questions.text: Who stood up against Israel and moved David to take a census?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:1 says Satan stood up against Israel and moved David to take a census of Israel.

questions.text: What range did David give Joab for counting Israel?
questions.explanation: David said, "Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word."

answers.text: From the Jordan to the sea

questions.text: Which two tribes did Joab not count?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says Joab did not count Levi and Benjamin, for the king's word was abominable to him.

questions.text: Which of these was one of the three choices Gad brought to David?
questions.explanation: Gad offered three years of famine, three months before his foes, or three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence.

questions.text: Why did David choose to fall into Yahweh's hand rather than into man's hand?
questions.explanation: David said, "Let me fall, I pray, into Yahweh's hand; for his mercies are very great."

answers.text: Because his mercies are very great
Because the army was too weak
Because the famine had already begun

questions.text: What were David and the elders clothed in when they fell on their faces after seeing Yahweh's angel?
questions.explanation: David saw Yahweh's angel with a drawn sword stretched out over Jerusalem, and David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

questions.text: What was Ornan doing when he turned back and saw the angel?
questions.explanation: Verse 20 says Ornan's four sons hid themselves, and Ornan was threshing wheat.

questions.text: Why did David refuse to take Ornan's place as a gift?
questions.explanation: David said he would buy it for the full price, for he would not take what was Ornan's for Yahweh, "nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing."

answers.text: Ornan was a foreigner in the land
Gad told him to pay the full price
The law forbade gifts from Jebusites
He would not offer what cost him nothing

questions.text: How much did David give Ornan for the place?
questions.explanation: Verse 25 says David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

questions.text: How did Yahweh answer David when he called on him at the new altar?
questions.explanation: Yahweh answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

answers.text: By a voice from the tent
By fire from the sky on the altar
